series_label: Proportion of population using at least basic drinking water services (Nigeria, Drinking Water, Total wealth quintile, Total residence)
source_or_custodian: WHO/UNICEF Joint Monitoring Programme (JMP); UNICEF SDMX flow UNICEF/WASH_HOUSEHOLDS/1.0
status_or_notes: Server returned 25 annual observations, 2000-2024; no observation for 2025. OBS_STATUS and footnotes were empty in the response.
definition: Percentage of the population using an improved drinking water source, where collection time is not more than 30 minutes for a round trip including queuing (improved sources include: piped water; boreholes or tubewells; protected dug wells; protected springs; rainwater; and packaged or delivered water)
